items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: we had done the Mildred Bailey show in the radio days, you know, with the trio.

ctx.x: me. Because we had done the Mildred Bailey show in the radio days, you know, with the trio. We were getting booked all over the place. On CBS, you know, and NBC and all those places, and we just happened to hit it, if I can put it that way, you know? The timing was right, a unique trio, a violin, bass and piano, playing jazz. No drums or nothing, you know, just -- we were very fortunate that way. And I think it was a wise thing that I didn't go with Benny Goodman. And I just wanted to stay in New York and expand…
Let's see, was it her radio show? It was her radio show. She had a big radio show in those days, on CBS, you know?
